question: What core democratic role of social media is highlighted in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Real-time public engagement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes how digital platforms enable instant communication between citizens and leaders, creating forums for debate, mobilization, and scrutiny—this is real-time public engagement.
 
• Other options, like election supervision, economic reform, and cultural preservation, are not the main focus of the passage.
 
• The core emphasis is on how social media connects people rapidly and enables immediate democratic participation.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Real-time public engagement

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Election supervision**: Not discussed as a central feature in the passage.
 
• **Economic reform**: Not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Cultural preservation**: Not addressed as a core function of social media here.
